submitted.rationale: I aimed the measurements at the rutile/trirutile Fe–Sb–O region (Sb about 0.5–0.75), where I expected the photoanode to be most active. Index 17 (Sb 0.601) gave the highest EQE, 0.0153%. The nearby points were all lower: index 15 (0.570) gave 0.0066%, index 12 (0.506) 0.0017%, index 21 (0.747) 0.0043%, and index 18 (0.643) a negative value, which looks like noise. All values are tiny, so the ranking is not certain.

rejected.reason: Negative EQE, probably noise, lower than index 17
